title: 200 Million Fibers Connect Both Sides of Your Brain
hook: 200 million fibers connect your brain's two halves.
closing: Your brain works as one team, so personality cannot belong to only one side.
question: Were you labeled left-brained or right-brained?

segments.say: Language sits about 96 percent in the left side for right-handers, but personality does not split by side.
Scientists tested seven brain networks, and none matched the left-brain, right-brain myth.
About 200 million nerve fibers link the brain's halves, constantly sharing signals across both sides.
